WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT r.name, SUM(CAST(res.points AS REAL)) AS total_points
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), above_average AS (
  SELECT name, total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
  WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)
), race_name_laps AS (
  SELECT r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
)
SELECT SUM(a.total_points) AS combined_total_points,
       AVG(l.avg_laps) AS average_laps_completed,
       AVG(a.total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)) AS average_excess_over_average
FROM above_average AS a
JOIN race_name_laps AS l ON l.name = a.name;
